hip_shoulder_separation.low_diagnosis: Limited hip-shoulder separation. Upper body rotates with hips, breaking the kinetic chain.
hip_shoulder_separation.low_fix: Hold-the-wall drill — keep front shoulder closed until hips reach 80% rotation.

head_stability.high_diagnosis: Excessive head movement. You're pulling off the ball.
head_stability.high_fix: Chin-to-shoulder cue. Keep eyes level through contact.

kinematic_sequence.binary_fail_diagnosis: Out-of-sequence firing — hands or torso lead the hips.
kinematic_sequence.binary_fail_fix: Tee work focused on hip-lead: 'hips fire first, then everything else.'
kinematic_sequence.binary_pass_strength: Correct firing order: hips → torso → hands.

bat_speed_proxy.low_diagnosis: Bat speed below elite range — limits exit velocity ceiling.
bat_speed_proxy.low_cost: Lower power output across all pitch types

swing_tempo.low_diagnosis: Swing is rushed — less time to recognize and adjust to pitch.
swing_tempo.low_cost: Higher chase rate on breaking balls
swing_tempo.low_fix: Slow rhythm drill: count '1-2-swing' through the load.
swing_tempo.high_diagnosis: Slow swing initiation — likely late on fastballs.
swing_tempo.high_fix: Earlier load — begin hand action when pitcher's lead foot lands.
